name: Universal TV Show Current URL
description: Shows the current page URL in a copy-friendly bar at the bottom of the screen

params.code: var urlBar = document.createElement('div'); urlBar.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;bottom:0;left:0;right:0;background:rgba(13,17,23,0.95);padding:8px 20px;font-size:14px;font-family:monospace;color:#58a6ff;z-index:99996;border-top:1px solid #30363d;cursor:pointer;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;'; urlBar.textContent = window.location.href; urlBar.addEventListener('click', function() { navigator.clipboard.writeText(window.location.href).then(function() { urlBar.style.color = '#34d399'; urlBar.textContent = 'URL Copied!'; setTimeout(function() { urlBar.style.color = '#58a6ff'; urlBar.textContent = window.location.href; }, 2000); }); }); document.body.appendChild(urlBar); return 'url-bar-added';
